scope: Numerical complete-window pulse/harmony and render verification; no human listening, labelled downbeats, phrase accuracy, physical iPhone or catalog word-error claim

karaoke.caveat: Synced LRC lines do not prove the times of individual words.

baseline.caveat: Simulates the actual player feature enrichment with guarded synced-LRC and validated beat-grid BPM. Still not an acoustic listening test, comparison with Spotify, or physical iPhone verification.

after.source: waveform-derived features, not double-blind acoustic listening
